world.rationale: Matches StreamK WorldId union (streamk-web/types/storyWorldGateway.types.ts) and studio-atlas authoring fixture id (dt4m-os apps/studio-atlas/src/lib/world-authoring/fixtures/living-forest.ts). Only the kernel vertical slice deviates, and it is a fixture.

nonProductionAliases.rule: Must never appear in any production projection, entry result or URL. The platform binds runtime world instances to worldId 'living-forest'.

identityRules.worldId: Immutable opaque kebab-case identity. Never display copy. Never reused.
identityRules.worldSlug: Routing/display slug. Equal to worldId at Launch-01 but independently changeable (old slugs redirect). Never used as a key in contracts.
identityRules.placeId: Immutable opaque kebab-case public identity of a place, unique within its world. Consumer contracts key places ONLY by placeId.
identityRules.placeSlug: Routing/display slug for a place; may change with redirects; never a key.
identityRules.separation: WorldK routes MAY use slugs; every contract payload, ledger row and link parameter uses ids.

placeIdentityMapping.semanticAuthority: StudioK Canon/authoring mints the place (IR Place.id, IR ids are opaque with no worldId — compiler schemas/ir/v0/common.schema.json).
placeIdentityMapping.runtimeBinding: AvatarK Platform Living World Host binds IR Place.id → runtime LocationId/PlaceDefinition.id → projection placeId in a platform-owned binding table.
placeIdentityMapping.consumerExposure: Only the projection placeId (+ slug/displayName) reaches WorldK. IR ids and runtime LocationIds are never exposed.
placeIdentityMapping.rule: projection placeId == canonical StudioK place id once canon exists; runtime LocationIds may differ and are mapped, never leaked.

launch01Places.reason: No Living Forest canon document exists (studiok-canon has none) and the two existing sources disagree: studio-atlas 'canopy-clearing' vs kernel slice locations 'forest-clearing' / 'forest-stream' / 'forest-pond'. M07 freezes the RULES, not these ids.

unreconciled.note: Placeholder authoring place; relation to runtime forest-clearing undecided.

narrative.note: 'The Forest Remembers' exists nowhere in any repository (M06). These slugs are proposed for the future StreamK launch config; StreamK owns the final values.
